dialogues.speaker: Flying Squirrel Fairy
dialogues.text: But... How could everyone just forget him like that? Does he need another blessing?

dialogues.speaker: Giraffe King
dialogues.text: He was bound to face challenges in the world outside the castle. It would have been a pretty boring journey otherwise.

dialogues.speaker: Cat in a Box
dialogues.text: If you ask me, the less eventful a journey, the better...

dialogues.speaker: Stray Cat
dialogues.text: If he ever runs into real trouble, he knows where to come looking.
